output: ^[1-9]\d* propert(y is|ies are) lost in [1-9]\d* of \d+ shipped themes \(BETA \d+\)$

steps:
1. Open themes\Dark.theme, in the folder of the twinBASIC installation, in a text editor. Line 63 is DiagnosticsGroupFontSize: 90% and ends without the semicolon that ends every other property. Line 64 is DiagnosticsGroupFontWeight: 500;
2. Open themes\Light.theme. Its lines 63 and 64 are the same.
3. Open ide\main.js and find applyThemeData, which loads a theme file. It removes the /* */ comments, cuts the text at each ';' followed by a space, a tab or a line end, removes the line breaks from each piece, cuts each piece at each ': ' and ':<tab>', and keeps a piece only if that gives exactly two parts. Lines 63 and 64 are one piece with three parts, so the piece is dropped and the loader writes no message.
scripts/probe_theme_semicolon.mjs applies that rule to every .theme file in the themes folder of the installation (the newest twinBASIC_IDE_BETA_<n> folder on the Desktop, or --ide <twinBASIC.exe>) and prints one line for each piece it drops, then a summary. It starts no IDE. On BETA 1005, 997 and 957 it prints the same two lines, DiagnosticsGroupFontSize and DiagnosticsGroupFontWeight lost in Dark.theme and in Light.theme.
